支持 PEM / DER 证书、P12/PFX 容器和加密 PEM 私钥；解锁密: Supports PEM/DER certificates, P12/PFX containers and encrypted PEM private keys. The password is used only for this import and is not saved. Windows encrypts the vault for the current user; other systems use restricted local files.
